# macOS status

macOS support belongs to the plan's later P1 work. This port has no qualified
macOS build, editor, renderer or exported-game result. Historical upstream build
branches do not establish support for the current Redot/SDK combination.

A macOS port must select and verify the appropriate licensed Core library,
matching Redot bindings and templates, architecture, renderer, signing and
packaging behavior. It must run the lifecycle, animation, visual and export
matrix on the target OS before a support claim is added. No verified macOS
installation recipe or binary is supplied here. Current desktop instructions
are [Linux](linux.md) and [Windows](windows.md), with scoped results recorded
in [current status](../current-status.md).
